name: databricks
description: Databricks workspace integration — run SQL on a SQL warehouse (Statement Execution API with inline JSON results), poll and cancel statements, browse Unity Catalog (catalogs, schemas, tables with columns), and list and trigger Lakeflow Jobs. Authenticates with a workspace Personal Access Token sent as a Bearer token.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Databricks SQL warehouses, Unity Catalog, and Jobs via the REST API

fields.label: Workspace URL
fields.helpText: Your Databricks workspace URL, e.g. https://adb-123.4.azuredatabricks.net or https://xyz.cloud.databricks.com (no trailing slash).

fields.label: Personal Access Token
fields.helpText: Generate in the workspace under Settings > Developer > Access tokens. Tokens are auto-revoked after 90 days of inactivity.

fields.label: SQL Warehouse ID
fields.helpText: SQL Warehouse ID from SQL Warehouses > Connection details.

tools.name: databricks.execute_sql
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary SQL statement on the configured SQL warehouse and return the result rows inline (JSON, capped at 1000 rows; statements producing more than 25 MiB of inline results fail outright). If the statement is still running after 20 seconds, returns the statement_id to poll with databricks.get_statement.

statement.description: The SQL statement to execute (e.g. SELECT * FROM main.default.orders LIMIT 10)

tools.name: databricks.get_statement
tools.description: Get the status and results of a previously submitted SQL statement by its statement_id, fetching additional result chunks when the result is chunked (rows capped at 1000).

tools.name: databricks.cancel_statement
tools.description: Cancel a running SQL statement by its statement_id.

statement_id.description: The statement_id of the running statement to cancel

tools.name: databricks.list_warehouses
tools.description: List the SQL warehouses in the workspace with their id, name, state, and size.

tools.name: databricks.list_tables
tools.description: Browse Unity Catalog: with no arguments lists catalogs; with catalog lists its schemas; with catalog and schema lists the tables with their column names and types.

catalog.description: Catalog name (e.g. main). Omit to list catalogs.

schema.description: Schema name within the catalog (e.g. default). Requires catalog; omit to list schemas.

tools.name: databricks.list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs in the workspace with their job_id, name, and creator.

tools.name: databricks.list_job_runs
tools.description: List recent job runs with their run state, result, start time, and duration; optionally filtered to a single job.

job_id.description: Only list runs of this job. Omit for runs across all jobs.

tools.name: databricks.run_job
tools.description: Trigger a job to run now and return the new run_id. Runs whatever tasks the job defines (notebooks, pipelines, scripts).

job_id.description: The job_id of the job to trigger (see databricks.list_jobs)
